page.overview:
Who is Captain von Eitel?

Captain von Eitel was a pirate active during the 9th century PD.

He abandoned his family to become a pirate, and boasted about it often. Farah Vallari met him, and years later, around 839 PD, she met an adventurer, Gavain von Eitel, who had both the looks and the surname of the captain, correctly guessing Gavain was his son.
